# CombineClasses: classes sharing at least 3/4 of their properties with
# compatible types form cliques; each clique is unified. The clique a class
# joins moves to the front. A second pass (only with same properties) is
# Run's cleanup.
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
prim b bool
cls c1 a:i,b:s,c:b,d:i n=C1
cls c2 a:d,b:s,c:b n=C2
cls c3 x:s,y:s n=C3
cls c4 a:i,b:s,c:b,d:i,e:s n=C4
cls c5 x:s,y:s,z?:nul n=C5
cls c6 a:s,b:s,c:b n=C6
union nullable c5,nul n=Nullable
cls c7 x:nullable,y:s n=C7
cls c8 p:i n=C8
cls c9 p:i n=C9
ucls fixed fixed p:i n=Fixed
arr arr c4
cls top c1:c1,c2:c2,c3:c3,c4:arr,c5:c5,c6:c6,c7:c7,c8:c8,c9:c9,f:fixed n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
query named
combine conflate debug
combine same
gc
print

# Alphabetized properties make the reconstituted classes unique.
builder alpha
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
cls c1 b:i,a:s n=C1
cls c2 b:i,a:s,c:i n=C2
cls c3 z:s,y:i n=C3
cls top c1:c1,c2:c2,c3:c3 n=Top
top Top top
finish
combine alpha conflate debug
print
combine alpha same
gc alpha
print

# Without number conflation, integer and double properties don't match.
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
cls c1 a:i,b:s,c:s,d:s n=C1
cls c2 a:d,b:s,c:s,d:s n=C2
cls top c1:c1,c2:c2 n=Top
top Top top
finish
combine
print
combine conflate
print
